title: centaurea aeolica subsp. pandataria
intro: Centaurea aeolica subsp. pandataria, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea aeolica subsp. pandataria include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
